name: Maks Energy Solutions India Ltd.
summary: Maks Energy Solutions India Ltd. manufactures, supplies, sells, installs, services, and commissions diesel generator sets, marketed under the "Maks Generators" brand, with capacities ranging from 15 kVA to 1250 kVA. The company also engages in the trade and export of spare parts for diesel engines and earth-moving equipment, including accessory drives, cylinder blocks, and metal crankshafts. Additionally, it manufactures electric vehicles and their related spare parts and accessories, and trades in automotive and commercial vehicle components. Maks Energy Solutions India Ltd. operates within the industrials sector, focusing on machinery, tools, heavy vehicles, and power generation equipment, including electric motors and transformers. Its primary market is India, and it exports products to international regions such as Europe, Latin America, the United States, Singapore, the Middle East, Africa, Thailand, Nepal, and Sri Lanka. The company also offers generator rental services.
